success_criteria_results.criterion: The update is visible to the permitted test identity

observations.text: The agent opened https://clickup.com/ and the landing page loaded.
The agent clicked a button with role "button" and label "Dropdown menu".
The agent clicked a button with role "button" labeled "Direct Messages" and then clicked a button labeled "Don't update".
The agent clicked a span element labeled "Favorite".
The agent clicked a button labeled "Add Task".
The agent typed 'Demo Alpha' into a text field and clicked a button labeled "Create Task".
The agent clicked a button with aria-label "Create task" and typed 'Demo Beta' into a text field.
The agent clicked a button labeled "Task" and typed 'Demo Gamma' into a text field.

The agent reported successful creation of the project 'Demo Alpha' with three tasks: 'Demo Alpha', 'Demo Beta', and 'Demo Gamma'. The agent also stated that the project and tasks exist and the update is visible within the ClickUp workspace.
